articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX opens 2026 with launch of Cosmo-SkyMed Earth observation satellite for Italy
articles.summary: The spacecraft was originally slated to launch nearly a week prior, but SpaceX ran into ground systems issues. Liftoff from pad 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base is scheduled for 6:09 p.m. PST (9:09 p.m. EST / 0209 UTC).

articles.title: SpaceX to lower orbits of some Starlink satellites
articles.summary:
SpaceX plans to lower the orbits of some of its Starlink satellites, a move the company says is intended to improve space safety following two recent incidents.

articles.title: Hubble Glimpses Galactic Gas Making a Getaway
articles.summary: A sideways spiral galaxy shines in this NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image.
